teaser.en: The 'home digger': a creeping weed believed to dig out the peace of a homestead.
teaser.sw: 'Mchimbaji wa nyumbani': gugu linalotambaa linaloaminiwa kuchimbua amani ya boma.

summary.en: Mtsimbikaya is a small creeping herb, Boerhavia repens. Its name, 'home digger', comes from its use in magic to stir up quarrels inside a homestead.
summary.sw: Mtsimbikaya ni mmea mdogo unaotambaa, Boerhavia repens. Jina lake, 'mchimbaji wa nyumbani', linatokana na matumizi yake katika uchawi ili kuchochea ugomvi ndani ya boma.

about.en: Mtsimbikaya is a low, sprawling herb with slender stems that spread over the ground from a woody rootstock. Its leaves come in unequal opposite pairs, roughly oval and often paler beneath. It bears tiny pink to purplish flowers in small clusters, followed by small, sticky, ribbed fruits that cling to passers-by.
about.sw: Mtsimbikaya ni mmea mfupi unaotambaa, wenye mashina membamba yanayoenea juu ya ardhi kutoka kwenye shina-mzizi gumu. Majani yake huja kwa jozi zinazokabiliana zisizo na ukubwa sawa, yana umbo la yai kwa kadiri, na mara nyingi upande wa chini una rangi hafifu zaidi. Huzaa maua madogo sana ya waridi hadi zambarau katika vishada vidogo, yakifuatwa na matunda madogo yanayonata, yenye mistari iliyoinuka, yanayoshika wapita njia.

where.en: It grows on open sandy ground, in compounds, along paths and on disturbed or overgrazed land.
where.sw: Huota kwenye ardhi ya wazi yenye mchanga, katika viwanja vya nyumba, kando ya njia na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa au iliyolishwa kupita kiasi.

culture.en: Pakia records that the plant is used to magically destroy the peace of a homestead (kaya) by 'digging out' (tsimba) internal disputes. It is one of a group of Digo plant names tied to disputes, alongside Chivuundza kesi, the 'case terminator', and Mvundza jembe, the 'hoe breaker', which are used to end quarrels.
culture.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba mmea huu hutumika kiuchawi kuharibu amani ya boma (kaya) kwa 'kuchimbua' (tsimba) migogoro ya ndani. Ni mojawapo ya kundi la majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayohusiana na migogoro, pamoja na Chivuundza kesi, 'mmalizaji wa kesi', na Mvundza jembe, 'mvunjaji wa jembe', ambayo hutumika kumaliza ugomvi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsimbikaya, also written Mtsimbi kaya, meaning 'home digger'. No shared names are recorded. In English the genus is called spiderling; its scientific name is Boerhavia repens.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsimbikaya, linaloandikwa pia Mtsimbi kaya, lenye maana ya 'mchimbaji wa nyumbani'. Hakuna majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine yaliyorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza jenasi hii inaitwa *spiderling*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Boerhavia repens.

reason.en: Agathisanthemum bojeri, used to end disputes (Chivuundza kesi)
reason.sw: Agathisanthemum bojeri, unaotumika kumaliza migogoro (Chivuundza kesi)
Nao pia unahusiana na kusuluhisha migogoro

reason.en: Another plant named for its ritual use
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine uliopewa jina kutokana na matumizi yake ya kimila
Jina linalosikika vivyo hivyo, Eleusine indica
